description: request-guard: every request to a public website counted and spaced, one ledger per machine. PreToolUse books or refuses the call; PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure on WebFetch learn from the answer (403/429/503 start a back-off). The command tries $KIT_PYTHON first (set it in the env block of settings.json; on Windows the path of a real python.exe, never a Store or PyManager alias, which other logon sessions can be denied), then python3, then py. Hook subcommands always exit 0 once an interpreter started, so the guard runs exactly once per event.

hooks.command: "${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" hook || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" hook || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" hook || exit 1

"${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" result || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" result || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" result || exit 1

"${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" result || python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" result || py "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/request_guard.py" result || exit 1
